questions.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple expresses a wish about the present.
questions.q: I wish I ___ taller.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + would for a wish about someone else's behaviour or a situation changing.
questions.q: I wish it ___ raining.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple for a present wish.
questions.q: She wishes she ___ more money.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + would for complaints about annoying behaviour.
questions.q: I wish he ___ shouting — it's so annoying!

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple ('were') for a present wish.
questions.q: They wish they ___ on holiday now.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + 'could' for a present ability we don't have.
questions.q: I wish I ___ speak French.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' about the present takes the past simple: 'I wish I were rich'.
options: I wish I would be rich.
I wish I will be rich.
questions.q: Which sentence is correct?

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple for a wish about a present situation.
questions.q: She wishes her neighbours ___ quieter.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + would for a wish that a situation changes.
questions.q: I wish the bus ___ come — I'm freezing!

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple for a present wish.
questions.q: He wishes he ___ a car.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple for a wish about the present.
questions.q: I wish you ___ me the truth.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple negative for a present wish.
questions.q: They wish it ___ so cold today.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + 'could' for something we want to be able to do.
questions.q: I wish I ___ go to the party tonight.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple for a present wish.
questions.q: She wishes she ___ to answer that question.

questions.explanation: After 'wish', use 'could', not 'can': 'I wish I could fly'.
options: I wish I knew the answer.
I wish it would stop raining.
questions.q: Which sentence is WRONG?

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple for a present wish.
questions.q: We wish our flat ___ bigger.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + would for a wish that a thing/situation changes.
questions.q: I wish this phone ___ work properly!

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple for a present wish about yourself.
questions.q: He wishes he ___ so shy.

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + would + infinitive for a wish about a change.
options: I wish it will stop raining.
I wish it would stop raining.
I wish it would stops raining.
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is correct?

questions.explanation: 'Wish' + 'could' for a present wish about ability.
questions.q: They wish they ___ afford a new car.
